           [PROPOSED] ORDER GRANTING ADMISSION PRO HAC VICE

       THIS MATTER comes before Patrick Schafer and Keven Gedko, Hearing Examiners for

the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission” or “NMPRC”) in this case, upon

the New Mexico Large Customer Group’s (“NMLCG”) Motion for Admission of Richard A.

Arnett and Thorvald A. Nelson to Appear Pro Hac Vice (“Motion”) filed on June 25, 2026,

pursuant to 1.2.2.9(E) NMAC.

       The Hearing Examiner FINDS and CONCLUDES:

       The Declaration and Registration Certificate of Mr. Arnett attached to the Motion show

that he is a member in good standing of the Bars of the States of Colorado and Texas and has

complied with Rule 24-106 NMRA by filing the requisite Registration Certificate of Non-

Admitted Lawyer with the State Bar of New Mexico.

       The Declaration and Registration Certificate of Mr. Nelson attached to the Motion show

that he is a member in good standing of the Bars of the States of Colorado, Montana, Nevada, and

Wyoming and has complied with Rule 24-106 NMRA by filing the requisite Registration

Certificate of Non-Admitted Lawyer with the State Bar of New Mexico.




[PROPOSED] ORDER GRANTING ADMISSIONS PRO HAC VICE
Case No. 25-00079-UT
                                               1
        IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       The Motion is GRANTED. Richard A. Arnett and Thorvald A. Nelson are admitted to

appear in this proceeding pro hac vice through local counsels, D. Austin Rueschhoff and Austin

W. Jensen.


       ISSUED at Santa Fe, New Mexico this ______ day of June, 2026.

                                           ________________________________
                                           Patrick Schaefer and Kevin Gedko
